protocol.percentile: nearest rank: sorted[ceil(0.95*n)-1]; p50 is conventional median
protocol.dataset: 32 independent ready worker tasks returning 42, plus production-created lead supervision task(s)
protocol.ready_timestamp: TaskRecord.created_at from durable SQLite; effective eligibility is max(task.created_at, team.started_at), since created teams cannot dispatch. No task timestamp or clock is changed.
protocol.entry_timestamp: time.time() at the first line of synthetic Brain.complete after parsing task payload; raw perf_counter also retained
protocol.active_definition: Inference async generator has entered and has not exited. 31 first worker calls are held until an actual normally scheduled lead call also enters; all 32 stay held until real storage attempts and persistent agent roles are inspected.
protocol.warmup: No explicit warm-up or discarded trial. Three fresh service/team/SQLite directories in one Python process; Python imports and OS caches are naturally warm after first use.
protocol.budget: Explicit predeclared 10,000,000 synthetic token ceiling, local concurrency 32, logical worker identity limit 64; unchanged from the old local benchmark. No budget or scheduler setting is modified during a run.
protocol.implementation: Actual LocalSwarmService, TeamStore SQLite, production dispatch, reservations, lead scheduling, ToolExecutor and verification path. Synthetic inference and SyntheticSandbox tool output; NoNetwork egress. This is dispatch proof, not native sandbox throughput or model quality proof.
protocol.resource_sampling: 50 ms process RSS/thread/system-CPU samples. Shared desktop; other processes are not stopped. CPU time is this process only. Files retained per run under .tmp.
protocol.pass_definition: Every trial has a real peak of 32 active inference calls and storage attempts (31 workers + 1 lead), all first-inference task queue p95 <= 1 s, terminal succeeded and zero reserved tokens. Capacity-delayed 32nd worker remains included in full task distribution.
